# QuorumX

QuorumX indexes public DAO governance proposals and publishes source-grounded due-diligence records.

- Public proposal index: https://quorumx.dev/#proposals
- Methodology: https://quorumx.dev/#methodology
- Public API readiness: https://api.quorumx.dev/health/ready
- Source repository: https://github.com/luch91/QuorumX

Due-diligence records support human review and are not voting recommendations.
